mfa.resetHint: For someone who lost their phone: removes the app and ends their sessions. They sign in with the password alone and set up another.
mfa.resetDone: 2FA reset; the person's sessions were ended.

lock.lockedHint: Locked after repeated wrong passwords, until {{time}}.

accessRetention.invalid: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Build conversational assistants on top of your SyncroFin data. Each agent can have its own knowledge base, tools, and provider.

suggestions: what's my biggest expense category this month?
show my expenses by category as a pie chart
compare my income vs expenses over the last 6 months
how much have I spent in total this month?
which categories grew the most month over month?
summarize my spending trends and flag anything unusual
what's my net worth right now?
how am I doing against my budgets this month?

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.subtitle: Create your first agent — give it a system prompt, pick a model, and start chatting with your finances.

globalChat.title: Chat
globalChat.empty: Choose an agent and start a conversation with your financial data.

form.name: Name
form.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a helpful financial assistant. Always cite sources...
form.connectionRequired: Pick a connection — agents need one to talk to an LLM.
form.needConnectionHint: An agent needs a connection (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, …) to talk to a model. Set one up, then come back here.
form.autoContextHint: Prepend a small primer with your name, currency, today's date, and account list at the start of every conversation. Saves the agent from having to ask. Turn off for pure knowledge-base agents.
form.isDefaultHint: Used by the global slide-over chat (⌘J). Only one agent can be the default — turning this on clears it on others.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? Conversations and uploaded knowledge will also be removed.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.subtitle: PDF, MD, or TXT. Pinned docs always go into context.
knowledge.empty: No knowledge yet. Upload a doc to enrich this agent.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Choose which tools this agent may call. Discovered from your MCP servers.
tools.empty: No tools discovered. Is the MCP server running? With Docker: `docker compose --profile agents up -d`.

conversation.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? This will also remove all messages.

mcpExternal.title: External MCP access
mcpExternal.subtitle: Plug an external agent (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, n8n, a custom client) into SyncroFin's built-in MCP server. The token below is scoped to your user and expires in {{days}} days.
mcpExternal.warning: Copy now — SyncroFin does not store the token, so we can't show it again. Revoke by rotating AGENTS_MCP_JWT_SECRET.

connections.title: LLM Connections
connections.subtitle: Add the LLM providers you want to use — local Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Pick one per agent.
connections.name: Name
connections.baseUrlRequired: Endpoint URL is required for this provider
connections.ollamaHint: If Ollama runs on your host machine, use http://host.docker.internal:11434 (Mac/Windows) or your host IP (Linux).
connections.openaiCompatHint: Just paste the host:port (e.g. http://192.168.1.142:1234). The /v1 path is added automatically. From inside Docker on Mac/Windows, replace localhost with host.docker.internal.
connections.apiKeyPlaceholder: sk-... or leave blank for local providers
connections.apiKeyPlaceholderEdit: Leave blank to keep the existing key
connections.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted using your instance secret. Never returned by the API.
connections.setAsDefault: Use as default for new agents
connections.deleteConfirm: Delete connection "{{name}}"? Agents pointing at it will fall back to the instance default.

empty.title: No connections yet
empty.subtitle: Add a connection to point SyncroFin at your local Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

node.invoicesHint: against what you have to receive and to pay
node.recurringHint: against what you were already expecting

rule.netOfWithholding: Known person, paid net of withholding
rule.partPayment: Known person, part of the amount
rule.severalInvoices: Known person, several invoices at once
rule.aggregatePayments: Known person, several payments for one invoice

cond.samePayee: the person is the one on the invoice
cond.amountRatio: the amount matches net of withholding
cond.window: up to {{before}} days early, {{after}} days late
cond.similarity: the description is at least {{min}} similar
cond.onArrival: when money comes in or goes out
cond.amountPartial: the amount covers part of what is owed
cond.amountSet: up to {{count}} invoices add up to it
cond.amountAggregate: up to {{count}} payments add up to the invoice

field.name: Name
field.outcome: What it does when it matches
field.outcomeHint: Link binds the payment on its own. Suggest sends it to the queue below for you to confirm.
field.window: How far apart the dates may be
field.windowHint: Late is counted from the due date, early from the day the invoice was written, so paying the day after issue is not weeks early.
field.similarityHint: From 0 to 1. Leave empty to ignore the description entirely.
field.scopeHint: Leave empty to apply to everything
field.foreignOnly: Only currencies other than the one this workspace uses
field.textHint: Several, separated by commas, means any of them.
field.triggerHint: Matching happens at two moments, and the evidence is not the same in both.
field.amountMatch: How close the amount must be
field.amountMatchHint: Compared against what is still owed, not the original total.
field.amountBandHint: About the payment itself: a size you do or do not want this rule handling.

amount.ratioHint: Uses the withholding rates for your country. Nothing matches until those are set.
amount.partialHint: For payments made in instalments. What is left stays open, and the next payment matches it exactly.
amount.setHint: For a payment that covers more than one invoice. If more than one combination adds up, we ask instead of choosing.
amount.aggregateHint: For a client who pays one invoice in instalments. We only ever suggest this; you confirm.
amount.setFeeHint: A share of what the invoices are worth, for a payment that moves net of a cut. Zero means the total must be exact.

queue.title: Waiting for you
queue.empty: Nothing to review. Everything matched on its own.
queue.declineHint: Not a match. This pair will not be suggested again.
queue.declined: Dismissed. We will not ask again

step.whichHint: Leave everything empty and it looks at all of it
step.match: When it counts as a match
step.matchHint: How closely the payment and the promise have to fit

trigger.money_arrives: When money comes in or goes out
trigger.money_arrivesHint: The payment shows up on the statement and we look for the invoice it settles.
trigger.invoice_issuedHint: The payment came first and the invoice follows, so we look back at money already there.
trigger.bothHint: The rule is trusted either way round.

history.title: What matching did
history.empty: Nothing yet. This fills in as matching links, asks and is answered.

reconciliation.matchingHint: How each payment is bound to what it settles.
reconciliation.noneLeft: No matching rules left in this set. Nothing here is matched automatically.
reconciliation.confirmDeleteDescription: "{{name}}" stops deciding anything. You can bring it back later if it is one of ours.
reconciliation.invalidImportFile: That is not a matching-rules file
reconciliation.importOverwriteWarning: Importing replaces the matching rules this workspace has now, including their order. This cannot be undone.

health.title: Financial health
health.noData: Not enough history yet: add income and spending to get a score.
health.basedOn: Based on the last {{months}} complete months
health.forecastAria: Projected balance over the next 90 days
health.negativeWarning: At this rate the balance goes negative from the week of {{date}}.
health.assumptions: Projection from recurring bills and open invoices only. It does not guess at everyday spending, credit-card bills or foreign-currency invoices.

accountantExport.title: Export for your accountant
accountantExport.description: The period's transactions and summaries as spreadsheet-ready files (CSV) that open directly in Excel.
accountantExport.encryptionNote: The zip will be AES-256 encrypted. Share the password through a different channel than the file.
accountantExport.contents: Includes: transactions, summary by category, monthly summary, chart of accounts, accounts and invoices (receivable and payable). Transfers between your own accounts are not counted as income or expense.
accountantExport.periodInverted: The start date cannot be after the end date.
accountantExport.passwordPlaceholder: Leave blank to send it unencrypted

help.panelDescription: Help for the screen you are on.
help.notTranslated: This page is not translated yet, so it is shown in Portuguese.
help.unavailable: There is no help page for this screen yet.
help.noResults: Nothing found for "{{query}}". Try another word.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Who did what, when and from where. Every creation, change or deletion of financial and configuration data is recorded here and cannot be edited or erased, not even by system administrators.
audit.exportFailed: Could not export the audit trail.
audit.ownersOnly: Only people with the permission to see the audit trail (by default, owners and managers) can open this page.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the audit trail.
audit.openFromSettingsHint: Who changed what in this workspace.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.intro: Besides Owner, Editor and Viewer, you can make roles of your own for this workspace and choose exactly what each one may do. Every member still sees the workspace's data; what changes is who can change it, export it, see the audit trail and administer.
roles.none: No roles of your own yet. Make one, for example, for the accountant (read and export only) or for whoever enters expenses.
roles.dialogDescription: Give it a name and tick what this role may do. A change takes effect at once for everyone who has it.
roles.name: Name
roles.templateHint: Picking a template ticks its permissions; you can adjust them afterwards.
roles.readsEverything: A member can always see the workspace's data. The permissions below control what they can change, take out of the system, and administer.
roles.errorNameTaken: A role with this name already exists.
roles.errorNameBuiltIn: That name belongs to a built-in role. Pick another.
roles.errorInUse: Members still hold this role: change theirs before deleting it.
roles.errorTooMany: The limit of roles of your own has been reached.

transactions.write: Enter, change and delete transactions and attachments

members.manage: Invite, remove and change members' roles

tokens.manage: Create, rotate and revoke API tokens

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.intro: Credentials for programs (integrations, scripts, the accountant's system). Each token works for this workspace only, can do only what you tick and never more than you can, and always expires. The secret is shown once.
apiTokens.newBody: Give it a name that says what it is for, and tick only what it needs to do.
apiTokens.name: Name
apiTokens.durationHint: After this the token stops working. You can make another (or rotate this one) whenever you like.
apiTokens.scopesHint: A token only sees this workspace's data. Administrative permissions (members, roles, tokens) cannot be given to a token, and you can only give what you can do yourself.
apiTokens.secretBody: This is the only time the secret is shown. If you lose it, make another.
apiTokens.secretHowTo: Send it in every request's header: Authorization: Bearer <token>. Keep it like a password.
apiTokens.errorBeyondYou: You cannot give a token a permission you do not have yourself.
apiTokens.errorTooMany: The limit of active tokens for this workspace has been reached.

passwordPolicy.hint: At least {{min}} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, easy-to-remember password.

reasons.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: That password is too common. Pick something less guessable, such as a few words.
reasons.PASSWORD_HAS_EMAIL: The password must not contain your e-mail address.
reasons.PASSWORD_TOO_SIMPLE: That password is too simple: it repeats one character or is an obvious sequence.

accessLog.title: Access log
accessLog.description: Every sign-in, failed attempt, lock, ended session and API-token use. Kept for {{days}} days, without any way to edit or erase it; after that the records are anonymized (person, address and device are removed).
